author: AtditC
body:
Hello Avicus Staff members!

Here the most obvious evidence of Arcane_Horror using Aim assistence!

Name of player being reported: Arcane_Horror
Rule broken: AimBot > Hacking
Evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HNLVnFe_BOE
Anything else you would like to add? If you set the speed of the second part of the video to 0.25, you clearly see that his aim assistance moved towards the head of the left player, and while the left player was jumping, also Arcane_Horror's Aim assistance followed his jump. After he got knocked away, you can see his Aim assistance following the head of the target in the exactly same way as before. This cannot be human. He could not have faked AimBot.

Who ever reads this, please get one of the most experienced staff members of Avicus, who knows much about hacking clients etc. to judge about this. I know this isn't very much evidence but it is so obvious that it must be enough for a final ban.

Also, he's been banned now 4 times for AimBot and always has been unbanned again. Why is it so easy for him to get unbanned? You can't just say "[...] he's just good, he's not hacking! [...] he's been unbanned 3 times, why not just a fourth time? [...]" I really want the staff members to take this case serious.

By the way: I always thought he was a legit player until I coincidentally recorded him. My intention was actually to learn how he's pvping by spectating. When I saw this weird move happen, I knew from one moment to the other, that he's not legit.

Greetings,
-Atdit
